Drunk 1.note: Swapped onto the same drunk player on the third night; it comes off the next night.

Drunk 2.note: Swapped onto the same drunk player on the second night.

Drunk 3.note: The player of the in-play character the Courtier named, on the first night of drunkenness.

No Ability.note: On the Courtier once the drunkenness has ended.

setupPrep.none: its tokens mark what a player chooses at night, placed when they choose

reminderMovement.why: The chosen character is drunk for three days; the choice is made once.

reminderPlaceholders.note: The chosen character's player is drunk for 3 nights and 3 days; the ability is used.

full.text: The Courtier might choose a character. If so, that character’s player is drunk: mark them *DRUNK 3*, and mark the Courtier *NO ABILITY*.
full.reason: Says which token goes on whom.

full.text: Count down an existing drunk token: *DRUNK 3* becomes *DRUNK 2*, *DRUNK 2* becomes *DRUNK 1*, *DRUNK 1* comes off. The Courtier might choose a character. If so, mark that character’s player *DRUNK 3*, and the Courtier *NO ABILITY*.
full.reason: Says how the drunk tokens count down over 3 nights and days.
